boundary: Five exact workstreams; no full q5 or Z/9 image classification.

pass543.boundary: Exact association and tangent/quadratic image; not a complete enumeration of the 2,034,735 q=5 section orbits.

linearized_block_map.conclusion: Every A5 irreducible survives; spectral collisions are nonlinear, not a missing-irrep effect.

quadratic_charpoly_coefficient.conclusion: e2 depends only on the coordinate square-class histogram.
quadratic_charpoly_coefficient.real_basis_t_relation: tr(N_c^2)=20-10t for c=+-1 and 30+10t for c=+-2, t=zeta5+zeta5^-1

pass544.boundary: Classification is for the fixed Pass-540 magnitude profile, not all full-support q=5 sections.

cohomology.closed_cycle_observables: blind to every vertex sign switch

pass544.conclusion: The exact spectrum-preserving fibre is a nonlinear 80-word subset of the 12-cube, not a binary linear kernel.

pass545.boundary: This lifts the half-spin transposition, not the full order-three triality as a similarity of qutrit blocks.

heisenberg_lift.conclusion: The two half-spin blocks fuse by an antiunitary Clifford symmetry. The vector block cannot join because its characteristic polynomial is different.
heisenberg_lift.operator: normalized qutrit Fourier transform composed with complex conjugation

section_triality.outer_reason: SL(2,3) preserves support, whereas T sends support one to support four.

pass546.boundary: Exact Fourier decomposition and an exact 81-section nonlinear slice; not the full 9^40 characteristic image.

linearized_characteristic_map.conclusion: All 40 coordinate modes, including every Fourier character that occurs, survive in the first-order Heisenberg block image.

nonlinear_base_slice.conclusion: The naive q=3 orbit table does not lift equivariantly: its seven signed orbits split into thirteen Z/9 characteristic polynomials.
nonlinear_base_slice.definition: primitive offsets constant on each of four tetrahedral fibres, values 0,3,6; deep anchors zero

pass547.boundary: An all-exponent valuation theorem is proved for the one-pair orbit. Constant and odd-switch families receive exact recurrences and covariance, but no claimed closed valuation formula.

constant_family.relation: sigma_2 Galois conjugate; therefore identical lambda-valuation sequence

odd_switch_family.relation: The Pass-540 odd icosahedral switch has one shared order-five recurrence for every trace power.

one_pair_theorem.all_m_valuation: v_lambda(tr D^m)=infinity for odd m; for even m=2r it is 2m when r is even, and 2m+2+4v_5(r) when r is odd
one_pair_theorem.power_sum_recurrence: R_r=5*pi R_(r-1)-25*u R_(r-2), R_r=tr(D^(2r)); odd traces vanish
one_pair_theorem.proof_dependency: Uses the elementary Fibonacci valuation identity v_5(F_r)=v_5(r), derived from rank of apparition 5 and the F_(5n)/F_n identity.
one_pair_theorem.relative_norm: N(S_r)=4L_r^2 for even r and 20F_r^2 for odd r
